comparison.objective: Build a standing DUPLO bridge by joining a spanning brick to two pillars; candidate fractures and recovers four installed HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Bridge task tests bimanual pillar stabilization and press-fit brick attachment; candidate tests recessed coaxial mandrel placement, controlled hammer impact, and tiny-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Bridge must remain standing. Setup and scoring details are missing; candidate additionally requires four contact-driven fractures, four contained tangs, retained inserts, no damage, released tools, and two-second stability.
comparison.reason: Both involve bimanual stabilization, but construction by press-fit attachment is meaningfully different from notch fracture under controlled impact followed by fragment containment.
